QuestionStmt.S: Which of the following is a dihydric alcohol?

Solution.S:
Step 1: A dihydric alcohol contains two hydroxyl (—OH) groups.

Step 2: Ethylene glycol has the formula $\mathrm{HO-CH_2-CH_2-OH}$. It contains two —OH groups, so it is a dihydric alcohol.

Step 3: Glycerol has three —OH groups (trihydric), Sorbitol has six —OH groups, and Methanol has only one —OH group (monohydric).

Final Answer: $$\boxed{\text{Ethylene glycol}}$$

Hence, the correct option is B.
